column1: # text=The committee met twice in the spring to review the draft. Most members agreed that the plan was sound, but several asked for clearer costs and a longer trial. A small working group was formed; it will gather figures from each site, compare them with last year, and report back in June. Until then the current arrangement stays in place. Nobody expects a quick answer, and that is fine: a careful decision now will save time later. Questions can be sent to the secretary, who keeps the minutes and the list of actions.
